title: TOC Semio Window Tables
summary:
All document TOCs and register lists (\tableofcontents, \listof*) now render as hierarchical Semio Table windows with Nr./Titel/Seite columns and child indent from section number depth.

- \semio@render@toc and \semio@render@register open a Table window (title bar chrome) and render \SemioTableRegister with header + body rows
- TOC entries tracked via .sctoc aux file and \SemioTocTrack on heading hooks
- \SemioTableRegisterRow indents the title column by dot-count × 2 × spacing for child hierarchy
- Register list mode uses \ifsemio@register@list (not heading-chips disable) to avoid incomplete \iffalse during window open
- Fixed semio-core duplicate author-chip definitions and \semio@if@heading@chips register-list branch
- zwischenbericht and report templates build (light + dark)
